text:
Don't believe the reviews. The CRABS at joes CRAB SHACK was horrible. 
I don't know how they are still open. 

They tasted like a sloppy fishy mess. I can't believe were that bad. 
I went specifically for queen crabs and no, i don't want nothing else. Ugh!

Nonna's let us in 10 minutes before closing time and they let us order and take to go. The people who work here were so kind and generous and were able to help me and my friend buy something quick. We got our food no later than 7 minutes and left before 2 minutes before closing time. They gave us great service in an easy amount of time.

Came in for some drinks and food with friends around 10ish on a Friday evening. The place was rather slow, so we were seated immediately. They had some nice beer options on the menu, but about 5 options were not available. Our waiter Trish was accommodating and allowed us to sample some of the beers and walked us through the food menu. 

My 2 friends ordered the chicken sandwich which sounded good, but on the contrary was actually bland and lacked any type of excitement. 
I had the mac and cheese. Had a decent flavor, but  also wasn't all that great. Overall, the food was okay, nothing special.

The ambiance was quiet and low lighting with games playing in the tv. The spot appears to get more filled after 11pm as they close at 2am.
Super friendly staff! Great speaks (the gumbo was awesome). Wide variety of menu items to match anyones taste (veggie, vegan, allergies). It's kinda in a weird spot, but the inside is really cool.

Montecito Burger (back) and Leadbetter Burger (front). 

Although I was sad to see the previous Grill leave as it was one of the first places I had ever ate at when I came to Santa Barbara, I am very pleased with Mesa Burger replacing it. I love that they kept indoor and outdoor seating. Really nice look on the inside with the clean and shiny stainless steel. They have a burger that is the special of the day, which I ended up getting (Leadbetter). 

The Leadbetter has crushed guacamole and pineapple on top. Usually I am all for burgers that have pineapple on top as it has a nice terrikyaki and sweetness aspect to it. However, this one was different. It was diced pineapple more of what you would find in a fruit salad. I wasn't a huge fan of it ON the burger but separately it was good. That being said the actual burger was PERFECTLY cooked. Nice and juicy bursting with flavor.

My boyfriend had the Montecito burger, which honestly he INHALED because he found it so delicious. It had grilled onions and mushrooms on top which hit the spot. 

Fries came on the side and were so good! Kind of had a garlic seasoning on it (and they weren't even the garlic fries!) but as I always say, you can never have enough garlic!

Like the difference between a person as they are in high school versus where they were in middle school. Yeah, they are growing up, acting more adult, there's a little more polish on how they speak and interact - they are miles from where they were a short while ago - but there's still a ways to go to be as grown up as a college kid or somebody working. 

Not a ton of reviews for this place yet. Lots of 2 stars for start up issues, so I'm willing to offset with a 4 star. 

I had 2 of the big burgers - yeah that's right, 2 (shut up, I run a lot :))the cowboy and the caliente. I took them to go (that's my plating in the pics at the office, not theirs). 

Both were pretty good burgers. I opted for the dry aged on the caliente and liked that less than the angus on the cowboy. The former meat ate a little "food service-y" on the tongue. That said, the habanero aioli and grilled jalapeños weren't too crazy hot. Just enough to make it interesting and not make you sweat. I appreciated the greens were mixed and colorful. 

Cowboy burger had a tangy bbq sauce that didn't try to hard on either the sweet or tangy side - nicely balanced on the whole. If you mess up and onion ring you should be shot, but they didn't. 

Buns were right and tight so to speak - maybe more soft and buttery with a touch of sweetness. 

So, not the most grown up burger I've had, but more interesting than 5 guys, and far more so than other fast food.  4 stars might be too much, but 2 stars isn't fair at all.

This hotel is absolutely STUNNING! The inside is filled with beautiful greenery & a variety of restaurants. When we checked in, we were greeted and helped with our luggage. They even took it up to our room & unloaded it for us. They had live music and a fountain show. Our room was clean and ready for us early which was a nice surprise after traveling all day. The only reason why I gave this hotel 4 stars instead of 5 is because it was a bit confusing upon arrival. The signage outside the building and inside was very vague which was surprising for how large the facility was.

In the area on business. Found the establishment on Yelp and gave it a shot. The pizza was good. The fried pickles I ordered had nice flavor. The beer selection and the cocktails available were the highlight to me (along with the pizza). Sat at the bar to watch the Phillies game while enjoying my meal and drinks. Cool music playing in the place as well. Give it a shot if you want to have some good drinks and food to accompany them. I would come back for sure.

Best Caribbean spot I've had in Philly! The jerk chicken, mac & cheese, and kale were exceptional. And the sauces really took things to another glorious level. You won't be disappointed if you check this spot out.

What a romantic place. The service was on point and friendly, never felt rushed. Food was excellent, and appealing to the eye. Wine selection was perfect. This was our first visit, we will be returning.

First time trying this little jewel. Our waitress, Marina, was so sweet and knowledgeable of the menu. The waffles, pancakes, and French toast was on point. Add Fresh fruit, whipped cream, home fries and smoky bacon and you have a heavenly platter. Lol. Delicious!

Our family dinner was great. We decided to dine at Difabio's for a fun night out. The service and food were flawless.
My wife had the Brisket Wedge that was loaded with all the goodies and meat that melted in your mouth.
My daughter had the chicken Milanese that was enough for 2 people and so good.
I had my favorite, a moist and tender Jumbo lump crab cake with roasted fennel, slaw and finished with some lemon EVOO. This was a WINNER!

What happened Sal's? We normally have awesome pizza delivered from here, but this time it was Meh. The pizza seemed undercooked and even the pizza crust looked pale. Cheese was really dense and pizza was really oily. We hadn't experienced that before, so that was a bummer.

We also ordered cannoli in the past that was amazing, so decided on the tiramisu. It's $5.99 a slice and when we got it, it was a small, thin piece for the price, and most of it on the side of the container. Looked appealing but was a really bland tiramisu. Such a bummer.
Have ordered twice from Verona & very satisfied by the quality of food. Everything is fresh, excellent tasting, and seemingly homemade. Will be ordering again & again!

Let me start off by saying Jeff is awesome ! We were desperately trying to find somewhere that could host our rehearsal dinner ( small party ) he without a doubt did the best job ever . He reserved the whole patio for us .and was super sweet to our little ones . The food was out of this world great . Our bridal party is still craving it . Try the Alfredo ravioli. You won't regret it .  There were no mess ups on our food . Everything was wonderful . Give Jeff a raise !
By far one of my favorite places to eat in Manayunk!  Their unique burgers and tots are amazing!  And they have gluten free rolls that actually taste good!

Don't go for a colts game! Multiple times I have been there and have had to tell them to put the colts games on, and I was there to watch the last game of the season and as soon as someone else requested another game, they switched the channel and I was not able to finish the game!

Easy to find if you look for the long line of white people. If you can handle the wait, well...the flavor good, but it's within two blocks of so many other Mexican places that are delicious and charge a quarter as much. And the side of beans or rice comes in a container so tiny I thought it was a condiment.

This is my favorite Greek restaurant in Nashville! Everything is so delicious and fresh (the food is HOT HOT when it reaches the table). The service is quick and casual, yet they clearly take care to ensure exceptional quality + flavor in the food!!

My favorite order is the chicken rice bowl with a side of pita. It's sooo flavorful. The pita is homemade & hands down the best I've had in town!! I could eat here every day with so many yummy and healthy options!

My breakfast was really good. I had the cinnamon roll pancakes with scrambled eggs and cheese. My pancakes were so light and fluffy. I've never been disappointed with a breakfast at Denny's. Def recommend!

First time here. The place was immaculate and the server was attentive. I got a dinner special--meatball & veggie soup, salmon (always risky in a diner), mashed potatoes, chocolate pudding. All of it was delicious. The items in the bread basket were a bit dry. My friend ordered a chicken cheese steak and fries. She said it tasted great.
I would recommend and will eat there again if I'm in the area.

I've ordered from this place a few times. The flavor is ok but the crust is horrible. Stop saying its NY style. The only thing NY style about it is thin crust and its  round. Theres zero crunch to the crust. Completely soggy and droopy. It's been a disappointment.

This pork though. Omg so goood. This is one of their vermicelli bowls. 
Without fail, I always ask for an extra side of grilled pork because it's melt in your mouth delish. This is my second review. Can't figure out how to add onto my first review

Amazing, simply amazing. We tried a little of everything from each part of the menu and nothing was a let down. Each plate had new and unique flavors. It's hard to nail down what the favorites were for us but the short rib robatayaki, crab udon, and shrimp tacos are high up on the list. Sushi was also out of this world - especially the yellowtail toro. Cocktails are great here, we had the Two Lovers Knot which was was crisp and delicious. Truly, you can't go wrong. Service is worth mentioning too, the staff was attentive, but not over bearing. Enjoy!

I waited a bit before reviewing this place just to give them the opportunity to redeem themselves. Unfortunately, it went further downhill with each subsequent order. Pros: Fresh ingredients, extensive menu, well seasoned food & portions. Cons: Terrible when using a 3rd party delivery service. Food is thrown together, they'll replace dishes without asking, should they run out of whatever you ordered. Side options are always missing or much less quantity. They also charge MUCH more when using a delivery service and this is in addition to the delivery company's service fees, tax etc.  I picked up my order and it was $27.94, when I used a delivery company the SAME exact order was $40.28. Mind you, I get free delivery with my service and that didn't even include tip! After comparing their menu with what they put online, it's clear that they have up charged most items significantly. I stopped recommending this place to people as a result and refuse to order anymore from them. It's just bad business. I'll stick with Wing Lee Cuisine for authentic Chinese food.

This Taco Bell is usually pretty alright. I mean it's T-Bell, you know what you're going to get. But not the last few times.

I came by for the infamous nacho fries (which are usually amazing). This time wasn't as good as I could have hoped though. 

Although the nacho cheese was hot and delicious, my french fries were lukewarm. They tasted old, like older fries from earlier in the day. 

French fries can make or break an experience, and this time, my experience collapsed under the immense pressure of these less than savory fries. 

In addition to my fries seeming old-ish, the employee who put together my order seemed to haphazardly cast my fries about in the bag. When I opened my order, what I found was beyond comprehension. My cold fries were scattered around the bottom of the bag beneath a mountain of napkins and taco sauce. 

"What the heck!" - Me

I'm not saying you should avoid Taco Bell. In fact, I think you should give them another try. Perhaps, it was a new employee. 

I'll give it this T-bell a few more tries to get it together, and if things improve, I'll update my review.

This place is racist the old stubborn lady is a problem with a filthy attitude just like their  place had a weird smell I even saw a mice running around & that was enough for me to not eat their food I would give this place a negative 5 if I could if u like to be treated like a animal and eat unsanitary food be my guest

I like Jimmy's Pita and Poke a lot ever since they opened up a location on the northwest side. However this university location and their original locations sucks. I have heard bad things about this location before. But I wanted some poke on that side of town and ordered from the University location (DoorDash delivery) and tried to have no negative opinions going in. But after opening my bowl I noticed they didn't put any of the sauce I had asked for. Literally it was dry. The food and fish was fine and nothing wrong w that. But what the heck university location ? And the tea was nasty but oh well

I went in for a café con leche this morning.  The coffee was OK, but not like the traditional Ybor City Cuban coffee I was after.  It tasted more like a watered down latté. This is probably because this café would be more at home in Seattle or Portland.  Even so, on 7th Ave., you'd think the place could learn how to make a REAL cup of Cuban coffee.  I won't be back mainly because their politics.  I have major disagreements with the organization they overtly support.

Love the Parish. Their menu is full of delicious items   They're nice and helpful since I had questions regarding their menu. It was my first time having frog legs and they were great! It's nice to see other types of cuisine in Tucson other than the typical Mexican food here. I'd recommend it for anyone wanting something different but delicious. They also have a nice bar you can sit at too.

Ordered Deluxe pizza and onion rings for carry-out. Order was ready right on time and workers were friendly. Onion rings were still crispy when we got home and the sauce was a tasty horseradish sauce. Pizza was just as ordered and tasted great. The only thing that could be improved would be a crispier crust, but we would definitely order again.

Recently got a pizza and Caesar from here.  Prior experiences with sit down service in their old location were awful, but the take out pizza and salad were really delicious.   Hope the higher quality continues.

I LOVE this place. Whenever I'm in Tampa I get their trio app, a big ass corona, and burrito bowl. The atmosphere is always very jovial. Before covid19 
 they had DJ, lots of conversations and people. 

Still though they have a great staff, fantastic food. I've never left this place hungry or dissatisfied . Even if you have to get take out the trio app, corn on Cobb, and their bowls are amazing. Nothing disappoints!

I'm so glad to see Thai Chef & Noodle Fusion doing so well--they deserve it! There aren't many other restuarants that aren't chains in the area, so I love that this place is here. I live in another city, but I always make sure to stop by for a meal whenever I'm in the area. The atmosphere is great, very intimate with dividers separating each table and a small candle that you light yourself at the table. The restaurant is always spotless, even when it's busy, which is great.

The food and service is where this place shines. The waiters and waitresses are always super friendly and attentive--a few even recognize us and take the time to catch up with us a bit. You really can't go wrong with anything on the menu, but I really like their drunken noodle. The food always comes out quickly and is super hot and you get a LOT for the price. Trust me and the other reviewers and just come here!
Great food, close to The World War two Museum. Great place to hang out after the tour.

Folks, this is good pizza. Tried them out for the first time. I was a little skeptical bc of the huge PIZZA sign. I quickly realized these Italians know what they're doing. The name says it all. Very kind. Great service. Very reasonably priced. Tasted great and more importantly the Kids and Momma thought so too. Need I say more. Oh... even better reheated in the oven the next day. Ciao!

It's October 28, 2020, and I have reviewed a response to my review of JULY 3, 2020!  So zero stars if I could but it won't let me.  So neg 1 it is for this inconsiderate, unaccountable for their actions establishment.  How rude, and uncaring!  To be ignored, and my concerns unaddressed just fuels me more!  Tequila's Mexican Grill & Cantina YOU SUCK AT CUSTOMER SERVICE!!

I was in the area so I stopped by. I wanted to try the crawfish pasta with catfish it was awesome. The atmosphere was nice. My server Corey was nice, fast and enjoyable. He told me about the happy hour specials, didn't get it but I'll be sure to get one next time. To say I was by myself I had a nice time. So shout out to the bar crew!!!!

The fried green tomatoes. The fried oyster po-boy. The creamy grits. The crawfish gumbo with the okra. The Bourbon pecan pie. The sassy, retro chic waitress. It's been 2 weeks, but I still think about that meal...

Giwa is fabulous and is my go to new-person-at-work spot. The  food is tasty (with new things on the menu) and reasonably priced.  Service is good although occassionally a little slow if they're busy.  The food is always super fresh and most of it is deliciously spicy!  The Korean tacos are great as well as the hot stone bowl. if you're looking for some authentic high quality Korean food this place is a sure hit.

Overrated... ordered sandwich which came out looking like it had driven through a BBQ car wash with the windows down and fries were room temperature.  Guy taking order must have had somewhere better to be because he clearly wasn't interested in working at Bella's.  Food finally came after 15 minutes for a sandwich and fries.

Great little spot for Burritos and Tacos! It's never too busy and theybhaave phone in and Curbside Pickup. One of my favorite unknown spots in Reno! Take a moment to check it out and you won't be disappointed

Great outdoor seating that is Covid appropriate. Their food is pretty typical of the Mediterranean/middle eastern that you'd find in New Orleans but their outdoor seating is slightly better for people watching. I live in the opposite direction and I probably wouldn't make the hike unless I needed a change of scenery.

I'm on the way to Paladar 511 now.  Why?  Lemon Ricotta Pancakes!  Paladar 511 is,without a doubt, one of the finest restaurants in New Orleans... and, in. a city with Brigtsen's, Gris Gris and Commander's Palace, that's saying something!  The pancakes on weekend mornings are absolutely incredible. The only downside is Paladar's restricted breakfast/brunch hours (Satrurday & Sunday 10AM  - 2PM.  I suppose, if I coul ear lemon ricotta pancakes every day, I would weigh 800 ponds by now. I'll tell you one thing, 1:59PM on a Sunday is a very disappointing time, unless you're at 511Marigny, mopping up the last of the maple syrup.  Seriously, if you're in NOLA on the weekend, DO NOT MISS THIS!

This was an excellent choice for 14 person group.  The service was really nice.  Great happy hour specials.  Food priced decently and truth be told a deal given the quality.  Will be back next time we're in town.

Another solid restaurant from Alon Shaya. This one claims to be more casual but the food is still absolutely stellar. The hummus is incredible, the salatim are all delicious (I'm a big fan of the labneh and lutinista) and I had a phenomenal oyster sandwich. The pita is of course fresh, endless and melts in your mouth. It's still a little pricey but you certainly get your money's worth. I also appreciated them having non-traditional soft drinks such as house made sodas and tea. I'll be sure to return as often as I can.

I don't know what took me so long to come in to enjoy dinner here. But I'm feeling a little silly that it did. I got the opportunity to enjoy dinner with a few friends here recently, by reservation. And I definitely recommend bringing someone to share with. The fondue appetizer was super delicious filling and fun, and there were a ton of great appetizer selections to choose from. I got the lamb special and it was absolutely delicious, like a luxe homage to a classic tuna noddle casserole with creamy sauce, crunchy breadcrumbs, and fresh peas but amplified with shredded lamb. The service was great, even though the restaurant was extremely busy and the wine selection was perfect. Everything from the decor to the complimentary focaccia was a treat and I'll definitely be back.

Our big group grabbed an outside table since there was not much room inside - there was plenty of room outside given it was pretty darn cold for Florida.  The waitress was a lot of fun and did a nice job keeping our group in-line.

We ordered a couple of apps that were pretty good - the pretzel bites and the deep fried cheese curds.  Many of us are from Wisconsin and we are cheese curd connoisseurs - these curds were pretty darn good.

I ordered their wings with the sweet thai sauce and they were very tasty.

The beers were good too.

Thumbs up!
This place has great food. That atmosphere is a litte gaudy, but it sort of adds to the charm. The food has amazing flavors and is cooked perfectly.

We did takeout from this restaurant. Upon picking up, there was only one employee that I could see  and she was masked, so I felt very safe. I ordered the mini Mexican corn on the cob and the chicken fajitas. The mini Mexican corn in the cob was the star of the show. 5 stars! The fajitas were ok, nothing special. Overall, meal was good but a bit pricey.

Ordered handsome chicken lollipop and it came out literally with undercooked batter inside. Thought maybe it's just be one or two that were bad, so we tried another piece and that was also literally mushy batter inside. We sent it back, and instead of taking it off the bill or offering a new order, they still made us pay for it and only offered to re-cook the last two underdone pieces of chicken?? Who does that at a restaurant??
We love the food her!!!  Eat in, take out, or Uber Eats it is great. I would recommend it to everyone.
The customer service was very welcoming and hospitable. Food was even more delicious and satisfying. Very recommended !

Yelp you've done it again!!  Awesome find!!! What a great local breakfast spot! The portions are huge!!! The food was amazing!!  I had the build your own omelette. I added creamed chipped beef and American cheese.  So yummy!!! My friend had the block buster. She loved it and took so much home. It was enough for 2. Another friend had the eggs Benedict and another had the create your own. Everyone loved their meal!!  Tyler our waiter was very nice and attentive. Thanks Tyler!!!! I definitely recommend this restaurant!!!!

This was outstanding.  

The platanos came with this tangy cream sauce that set it off.  

The jalepeno and original pupusas were hella bomb.

The service was friendly AF. 

Side note: the pupusas were hella cheesy.  Which was to my delight but I'm sure to other's displeasure.
Love standard tap! First saw them on diners drive-ins and dives and was intrigued with the octopus! We now go there every Father's Day and it has never disappointed!

Had a delicious lunch here.  The crispy oyster taco, the crispy shrimp taco and the seared tuna street taco were fabulous.  We also had the island stack salad which was excellent.  The jalapeno cheddar grits and the roasted corn were also excellent.  I highly recommend this restaurant.  The outside dining is covered with a tent and very comfortable.

Came here while visiting Nashville and really enjoyed our meal! Our servers Heather and Olivia were friendly and very knowledgeable about the menu. We thoroughly enjoyed everything from the tuna tartare appetizer to the Waygu filets Kanye Prime is known for. We also indulged in a few side dishes, including an awesome creamed corn brûlée that had a flambéed crust just like a creme brûlée! They also had a great wine list and we had a wonderful 2013 Barolo with our meal. Heather did a great job tour guiding the menu for us so all of our decisions felt well informed. I highly recommend Kayne Prime for a date night or business meal. What a great spot to have a quality culinary experience in Nashville!
10/10 would recommend. Asgdsdghgdsaf gfxbjheruhchjjfsch kiufaxhihdth KOP it's good jkoutf kitecbkifs. Hours. Puff. Off. PhD. Lord. Lord nljv loud. Off
Rude cashier, asked for her name and she gave me her name as cashier ! they have awful customer service over the phone, I could only imagine how it would be in person. Very disappointed.
The food is GREAT!! Low wait times as well as good customer service! Just wish they could make their Horchata like they used to, it seems like they're always out of it nowadays

So so good! First of all the menu is so well done and very "cat"chy. They separate healthy and unhealthy food into the good cat and the bad cat. I was trying to be a good cat and they did have very tasty looking options, but ended up being a bad bad cat.  The crab scramble was so delicious! Packed with LA crab. I was very impressed with the taste. I also shared the scallop and grits. This had Nola bbq. I am typically not a bbq fan with grits but this one was an exception. The scallops were perfectly cooked and the bbq sauce was not overpowering and just perfect. The drink options were extensive, with a wide selection of teas (had the gunpowder green tea which was lightly smokey in flavor), coffee and cocktails. The waitress was very sweet and friendly. Already have told me friends and coworkers about this gem, and I cannot wait to go back.
Thank for the hookup guys it was great. I'll be back again soon! Very impressed in the options and quality and the dog bowl too! Great idea . Show some love peeps

Conveniently located to everything, next to Harrah's Casino, right on the Riverwalk with upscale shopping, less than one block to the street car public transit, Manning's is around the corner. Great views of the Mississippi River and you could see the cruise ships  from our room window. 
Don't miss a meal at Drago's withi g the hotel. Char broiled oysters are a must even if you are not an oyster lover.... these will change your mind. Catfish is hot and flaky, the tender fried chicken, greens & sweet cornbread were on point! 
A huge workout gym with plenty of cardio equipment. Private hot tub and saunas inside the locker rooms. 
Outside glass elevator for a cool ride, especially at night.

Ehhh. Monday night...six patrons in the entire restaurant. Service was painfully slow. You do specialize in wings, right? Drink was 3/4 full but full price. Sitting outside and ask if they could turn down the fans... we are the only ones sitting outside. It's already a comfortable 69 degrees so no need to shiver under fans blowing full blast. After asking more than once (very nicely), the waitress says she has to get a manager to turn down the fans.... we're cashing out and still no response. I could understand if the patio was full but we are literally the only ones outside and it's a switch. A switch you flip and can flip right back on. I doubt there's even a manager on site..... when asked, our server stumbles but manages to name 3. Apparently, everyone working tonight is a manager yet no one knows how to flip a switch or cares about the customers supporting their establishment.
Great food but not solid lines. Go to Charlotte or 8th location for better experience. Hot is HOT. Mild is hot. Great quality of hot chicken in Nashville

Dewey's pizza is so delicious! I frequent the Kirkwood and Webster locations and they are always amazing. I would recommend making a reservation at both locations. Some of my favorites are the porky fig, Ryan's inferno, and caprice. Their salads are also always fresh. I always get the Caesar and the side is a pretty good portion also. I would absolutely recommend going to Dewey's!

The roast chicken is awesome.  Drinks here are very good.  My favorite is the whiskey sour.   Staff is very accommodating and always there to make sure your experience is top notch!!  Will be back again!!
Great atmosphere for wonderful jazzy blues entertainment! I ordered the Smokehouse Burger which was AMAZING! My hubs ordered the seafood combo platter. Tons of food! Would visit again!
Cute little place, the homemade muffins were phenomenal. Only reason for 4 stars is because I think they just served yoplait and a premade chicken patty, but even those were fine.
Great gluten free options. Friendly and knowledgeable staff and quick service. Delicious food.

Wanting to help out local businesses during the pandemic, we've been visiting local restaurants. Went across town for tenderloin sandwiches at Dooley O' Toole's. We were overcharged for our pick-up order. On contacting them we were told they would not credit our card, and would have to drive back for a cash credit. Obviously, we will not be going there again or recommend to anyone. Bad business practices!

Wei Asian Cafe does delivery! One of the "gems" of the Eastside, this spot serves up major varieties of Asian cuisine. Granted, the majority of the dishes in the menu is mostly Chinese food but they have some Vietnamese, Thai, Korean, and more. So far, I had a craving for pad thai and their take has beef, shrimp, and chicken all in one dish! It was different but good. If you're wanting Vietnamese, they do have pho or bun thit nuong (grilled porkchop over vermicelli) or the spring rolls. The other dish that I really enjoyed from this place is the Eggplant with garlic sauce, which isn't always great in most delivery places but really packed well from them. I've never tried to dine in pre-covid times but from the quality of the delivery I'm sure the food is worth the try especially with the minimal options for Asian food this side of town.

We went the drive thru this evening and I can't recall the last time I've experienced more disinterested, disengaged rude employees.   Both the cashier was unfriendly but the food giver was just angry!

I asked for fries with no salt and while I quickly received my order, the fries were uncooked.     I would bypass this location in the future and just opt for a different restaurant in the area (as there are several options).   

I'm only writing a review as my friend mentioned this has happened to her at same location too.    As a an employer/owner, I would want to know and that my staff had further training.

This has become one of our absolute favorite spots.  Over the past few months we have just about ordered everything on the menu and have been consistently impressed.   The vibe is great, especially at the bar.  The service is always friendly.  The bar tenders are a step above.  True professionals.   The cocktails are excellent.   While we often stick to a simple martini when we go out due to the fact that drinks are expensive and we find ourselves disappointed at other restaurants, here we will order drink specials and cocktails that we would never try at other places.   The drinks are balanced and flavorful and that is hard to find.   We have added this to our mix of favorite places for lunch and dinner and could not be happier.  Definitely worth a try and sit at the bar if you can.
Quick bite to eat with Hubby, Business Partner and I had some great food. Food was off so good . The vibe was great. Alexis was very kind .

I've only had a take out order from here once, but it was delicious. We'd come over to see if taste of India had reopened, but they seem to be permanently closed. Wish we'd tried this place earlier because the food was better than than across the street. They're only doing takeout right now, so we sat in the parking lot and ordered online and it was brought out to us. We don't usually go for anything special, just got some daal and naan. It's a long drive but Lakeland doesn't have much for Indian. We'll be back, it was worth the drive.

Today was my second time  there and my wife's first. She is particular about her pizza but she loved it. We had a classic pizza and an order of wings. Both were fantastic as was the service. Victor was our server and I'd give him five stars as well. Very accommodating and pleasant to talk with. I'd recommend this place if you like authentic wood fired pizza with a warm atmosphere.
Really high quality fried chicken. Made when ordered and does not sit around. Popcorn chicken is very tasty and kids live it.

Just had the best dinner at El Ray Azteca Mexican Restaurant. They have new owners that are fabulous. They have a new seasonal drink menu and if you like pineapple and jalapenos you must try the pineapple jalapeno paloma. This young couple just bought this from the prior owners and if the service and food today is any indication of what their future holds, they will be successful. But right now, they need our help. They are doing a great job with social distancing and protecting us as customers. So please give them a try, their dining room is open.  And look out for a new surprise from them coming August 11.  They have now officially obtained our business anytime we want Mexican food.
Let's start with the service service is great very friendly faces and food was fantastic I had the green Chilaquiles and the quesadilla was delicious thank you very much keep up the good work!

My husband and I stayed here a weekend after staying in hotel in downtown Nashville for a work conference. What a contrast! In the best way possible. Walking in to this enchanting lobby I knew I made the right decision to come here verse continuing to stay downtown. 
There was a huge long line to check in but it moved swiftly. At the checkin I booked the least expensive exterior king room, however I was able to get an upgrade to an interior atrium view from the Cascades and I think that was crucial to enjoying this trip. 
It was a bit of a walk, and one could easily get confused with layout but we enjoyed the ride each time we left our room. 
The room was very updated and modern, compared to some rooms I saw online this one must have been updated, you can see they are actively working on updating all the rooms.
There is so much to do inside the resort, so many bars restaurants and shops. Not to mention multiple pools, spas and gyms to get a work out in (but again you're walking a lot)
The resort is next to the Grand Ole Opry and we caught a show..GARTH BROOKS nbd. It's also very close to a big mall. We walked there for food to give our wallet a break since the resort meals can be kind of spendy. 

I will say I wish this wasn't SO close to Nashville (about 30 minutes uber/shuttle) because I wanted to spend all my time at the resort, but felt like we should do one more day on Broadway but luckily we got a good deal on shuttle tickets and made the trip.

The day we left our flig

This was disappointing from the moment we walked in. Took forever to be seated, tables were not cleaned off, servers took forever to notice our presence once we finally got seated. (It was just my wife and I-2 people, not a large group) Our server just kept apologizing for not doing her job well. The food was mediocre at best. If it weren't for the hotel next door this place would close. The whole place was just dirty. I would not recommend this restaurant.

I ordered a cheesesteak and then saw on the menu taped to the window that they had a pizza steak.  I considered changing my order to the pizza steak but I did not.  I did not have high hopes for my cheesesteak.  When I opened the container I was very happy to see a nice big pickle with my cheesesteak.  I picked a piece of meat off the cheesesteak and much to my chagrin it was dry.  It was good meat but it was dry.  The kind of dry good meat that makes you drop to your knees, look to the heavens and say, 'God if you're going to send me to Hammonton can you at least give me moist meat?'  or wish that you changed your order to the pizza steak.  It needed a little more cheese and better melt.  Good roll.  The Root Beer Float was delicious.
LOVE, LOVE,LOVE. Prices are great and baked good ever better. I currently live in Maryland and introduced Stocks to some neighbors, they now request cakes when I go visit family in Philly!

Second lunch date at this place! We have always been welcomed by a friendly staff and a warm atmosphere! 

We brought our own wine and I loved that the server was quick to bring us glasses! We ordered the hummus tahini platter for an appetizer! The pita was warm and toasty! I loved the roasted peppers! I wish it was served with more cucumbers! 

For my entree I got the special- Bacon Jam Burger! I have had that blend of meats before at another restaurant, I have to say that this burger has less flavor in the meat but the jam and bacon certainly made up for that!! They kindly satisfied my gluten intolerance by serving it over a bed of chopped lettuce! 
My coworker got the veggie panini- she always loves that! French fries weren't anything to write home about. 

Overall I just love the cozy vibe on a great street in haddonfield! Will be back!!!

We had heard from several people that we needed to try this restaurant and took advantage of their re-opening to try them out.  First impressions are very important in a dining experience and from our first moments at Jewel of the South we felt very welcomed and were captivated. The customer service from all of the staff (especially Patrick) was truly exceptional and they went out of their way to make us happy in several ways.  Presentation was excellent and no detail was overlooked.  Even though we were outside (by choice) their courtyard is gorgeous and the marble tables and nice wooden chairs made it so pleasant.  All the drinks were amazing and their wine selection is impressive.  We can't wait to visit again!  We would definitely recommend.

Decent place right on the border of Chinatown and Market East. Lots of choices and the food comes out pretty fast. It's a BYO and if you ask for a wine glass or corkscrew, you'll have to pay a minimum of $3.  You could drink wine out of your empty water glass for free.  Really really good scallion pancakes. I want to go back just for those!

Hands down the best meal experience we had in New Orleans! The space is very hip and clean, and the service was pleasant. Started with drinks - the Batt Man (gin cocktail) was delicious, and my daughter had a pomegranate Shirley Temple. The cocktail menu was inspired and it was hard to choose. If you appreciate a well crafted drink, this is the place.

For entrees, my daughter had the shrimp kebabs (3) with hand cut fries from the kids menu. I had the Tartlet with local vegetables and it was beautiful to look at, as well as thoughtfully made! This meal had the perfect amount of herbs, goat cheese and veggies over a puff pastry. 

Surprisingly, this was one of the least expensive meals we had while visiting, and the experience was memorable! Honestly, I was a bit dejected after visiting a few recommended and popular FQ restaurants and having mediocre service and food, so SoBou revived my excitement about the French Quarter for food and was a highlight of our trip!
The lady straight up told me she couldn't cut my burrito because its a fire hazard, like seriously? Since when does cutting a burrito cause a fire hazard.  Its called laziness.

Went there last night  for the first time for my husband's birthday. We had steamers, fried whole belly clams, and a lobster roll. Nobody at our table was talking. The only sounds you could hear where, " oh my God " and ," yum ".
We felt like we were home in New England again. Beyond delicious! Everything and I mean everything was fresh; not rubbery, not over cooked; just perfect! We've had worse new England dinners in new England. Keep up the good work people we'll definitely be back! Thank you

Excellent service and friendly staff. Was steered in a different direction on brunch order (I thought I was ordering something familiar) and my waiter nailed it! Thanks Jamie!! 
Diner style atmosphere with fine dining service. The friendliest staff I've ever encountered. I will go out of my way to be back.
Great sushi!Portion sizes are nice. Tried the fried rice, pad Thai and some sushi rolls. I definitely recommend the sushi. The fried rice and pad Thai wasn't my fav. Will go again for only sushi.

Joanie's pizzeria is yet another of Soulard's many amazing restaurants. The toasted ravioli here is so good that I never even tried their pizza until I had been here about three times. They have both a beef and a spinach artichoke option for toasted ravioli, and honestly, you could order both and make that as your meal. It's literally that good. The sauce they use here just tops it off and puts it as one of the best in St. Louis. If you haven't filled yourself on the toasted ravioli, you will want to try the Doug's South Side pizza as well. It's a St. Louis style pizza, and is nearly as good as the toasted ravioli, and is cut into squares as a St. Louis pizza should be. Plus, they have a good drink selection to go along with the pizza and ravioli.

Great spot !!! Had eaten at the other location a few years ago. Was happy to see they moved into a beautiful new space ! The nachos are awesome, the chorizo taco was even better. Everyone enjoyed their meals and the prices are very fair. Would def be back when in the area.

A family-run operation.  Ryan is the son of the owner and really does a great job hosting the customer.  We accepted his recommendations for our lunch and it was delicious.

The fresh cod was unbelievable.  Loved every bite.  The three taco special was very tasty.  The burger special before 3 pm got our attention.  Got the Make your own burger with Provolone and bacon and it was a solid choice.  

We were there for happy hour and the drinks were flowing at our table.  

Excellent staff attention.  We loved our discussion about things with Ryan.  He is committed to serving the best meal possible.  Keep up the good work, young man.

We will be going back very soon and often.  We recommend the same for you.

Excellent location and use of space. They turned the pool club section into a Disney Princess brunch on weekends with socially distanced igloos and proper sanitization. This was an adorable idea for the kids, and quite nostalgic for the millennial mom. We had a great time twirling our dresses with the princesses. Their mimosa pitcher special was clutch. Do not skip the crab cake or fried chicken sandwiches as they were absolutely divine. 
Don't get distracted with Rose-colored glasses when it comes to cake and dessert. While their rainbow birthday cake is aesthetically pleasing, it tasted like stahl paint for icing and dry sponge for cake. Sweets are my passion, and the money/calories wasted on that poor excuse for a slice is absolutely a crime. 

In reality this should be a 3.5review, but rounding up for being dog friendlyPLEASE keep allowing the pups

Head for happy hour and skip the dessert-heed my warning. Not even our smallest, cake loving little one wanted anything to do with it.

Amazing pizza great service. Very home like feel, left feeling like I was a friend of the staff. Awesome pizza and hundreds of  craft beers to choose from will be back very soon would highly recommend.

I'm giving them a pass on the sloooow dinner (3+ hours) because it was Thanksgiving COVID style yet prix fix menu but despite the long waits they knew how to handle it, apologizing at every turn and providing complimentary cremant de Loire rose and a free refill of a glass of Pinot noir.  

Snacks and sides were extra and for $4 each, we really should have ordered 'one of each' but settled for:

*Fried Cauliflower - yummy grilled goodness, with a tangy drizzle of vinaigrette 
*Pumpkin soup - delicious and creamy with subtle  squash flavors, with hints of curry and almond 

Choice #1: Cold Apps
*Roasted Beet Salad - small but dynamic sampling making you wish for more - even an extra beet ball, smear of luscious Gorgonzola or bite of pistachio nut.  The edge is touched with ripe pickled persimmon.  

Choice #2: Hot Apps
*Mazeman Ramen Noodles with Uni - such a special dish with salmon eggs, and eggplant/tomato sofrito, adding spicy notes.   There's also an undisclosed white meat - likely a pork variety.  

Choice #3: Mains
*Risotto with Guanciale (fancy for ham)
Well made grains showing plentiful broth notes and salty ham.  Great for leftovers.  
*Shoyu Ramen - clearly, the evenings biggest disappointment. Shoyu is the saltier soy broth but when it's overly saturated to the point where the pork belly and shiitake are over salted, it's just overwhelming for the palate and you feel like you want to slide in some water to dilute.  I had higher expectations because of the solid rev

2nd time ordering placed my ordered the day before for a Sunday morning, still ended up waiting for my sandwiches when I got there. Order was wrong and the older woman with glasses at the counter was extremely rude to other customers waiting.

I have been here before and everything I ordered was delicious. I came back with my boyfriend and we ordered the same dishes as last time to share. We ordered the Cheesy Todd and Shrimp N' Grits. The burger was over cooked and they changed the Shrimp N' Grits sauce from a spicy sauce to like an Indian style sauce. We were both very disappointed. Please refresh the Shrimp N' Grits back to the old sauce. The chips were good though and the service.

I love Chili's! Every single time I have came to this location the hosts are always very polite and nice. You may have to wait 1-2 minutes for them to come to the front due to them helping out elsewhere but that's no problem. Every server I've had there is very attentive and super nice, no matter how late or how busy it is. The food is always good, as well as dessert. I will continue to keep coming here. Thank you!

Large hoagie, but sometimes its nice to be able to actually close your sandwich and eat it, couldn't do that with the hoagie I got, yet my wife's chicken cheese steak was very light on the portion. Potato salad is so so.
Had my husband's birthday dinner here ( 8 people) and food was great. The waitresses were terrific and we were allowed to bring our own cake

I love Galatoire's.  Years of tradition and a menu filled with awesome choices.  They must be largest purchaser of crab meat in New Orleans.  Fine dining.  Superior service.  Dining room without parallel.

Sadly my experience last Thursday night needs to be reported.  We were greeted and seated at a great table.  Dallas introduced himself and provided excellent service.  I have his card and will request him next time  We ordered Souffle potatoes and Galatoire Goute for appertizers.  The potatoes were not fresh and should not have been sent to the dining room.  The Goute is a feast for the gods.  My Godchaux salad was over dressed and kept it from being one of a kind superb.  My entree of veal chop was great.  My wife's trout almondine was not well seasoned.  

Why am I complaining?  Because for $300 you expect ever course to be perfect.  Will I come back?  Absolutely.  I hope management reads these reviews.  We live in the Garden District and have some good choices there, also.

Dallas is a credit to his profession.  And his drinks are excellent.

Went to pick up my dinner order. Small, quiet place. It was ready as promised, plenty for two (Chicken korma), spicy enough, quick, easy, snd good price.  Go there!

Chicken Korma

Wife and I ate here for the first time tonight based on a few other reviews and we were not disappointed at all. We both got the blackened fish taco and volcano shrimp taco. They were super fresh and full of flavor. The tacos come with chips and what tastes like a homemade salsa. We have frequent Jimmy Hula's but have to say Pearly's definitely puts Hula to shame. Only thing we are disappointed with is the fact that they don't have a location near us in Orlando.

Very displeased. Service was slow and very unreliable. The Mole was not mole... and for $20 it was a complete waste. The only reason I gave this one star instead of zero (if that were possible), was because the mezcal drink was the only saving grace. Will not return.

Nice little Tex mex place!  I've been once for lunch and purchased carry out once for dinner.  The lunch was pretty good, the carry out was not that great. 

Lunch: I enjoy all the  salsas to try.  The food was pretty quick and hot.  The prices are reasonable 

Carry out:  I purchased fajitas.  They weren't ready when I arrived.  I forgot to add some queso on my order and asked if I could purchase a separate amount.  It was a huge ordeal that 3 different servers couldn't figure out (I literally had cash in my hand).  When I got home I was had no tortillas.  So I essentially just had meat & toppings.  

I will go back sometime for dinner as I'd like to try a margarita and hopefully update my review.

We took a walk around the checkin area and casino while visiting Reno. I have been here countless times but maybe only stayed once or twice.

The theme is victorian and they have a lot of antiques in the registration lobby.

There is a cool pump-like device that covers the upper and lower level and has a dome that looks like you are staring at the sky outdoors. 

I went downstairs and there were maybe 5 black jack tables. Iam an excellent bj player and actually studied the game and usually win 3 of 4 times I sit down to play
 I always wait for the farthest left seat so Iam the last before the dealer to act so I can set them up with the bust card. I played 2 hours with $100 in chips. Ended up down $55 in the 1st hour, but played strong the 2nd hour until I won $70. 

Dealers and pit bosses were ok. Some dealers were nice. They all deal fast probs cuz the the casino demands it. The more hands dealt, the advantage spreads stronger for the house. I haven't been to Reno in maybe 5+ years and was a bit shocked when black jacks now pay 6:5 and not 3:2 that it has been forever. Another way these casinos are gaining more advantage. I normally will not play on bad odds or rules that are not favorable to the player but it was a short vacay so I said eff it as I had the itch to play. Even with this poor 6:5 BJ payout I still crushed them. I could have won more if BJs were 3:2 as I hit at least 10 black jacks in the 2 hours of play.

Anyways, the casino is average and has your normal tabl
The food was excellent  at a reasonable price..  the mac and cheese was delicious and the soup was excellent.  The service was great and they have both indoor and outdoor  seating.

Went here for dinner with my sister on a Saturday night. It was raining so we didn't get to sit outside and enjoy the spectacular view but we still enjoyed our experience. We started with the roasted cauliflower which was okay. I'm not sure I would order it again but I appreciate the healthy option. Next we split the Ribeye steak with mashed potatoes and broccolini. Once again, it was okay. Last we got a seasonal peanut butter tartlet which was the best thing we had that night. In my opinion this is a place to go to for the ambiance more than the food but overall great experience.

Hi, I am a frequent customer of Acropolis Greek, and I am disappointed with the service from my order on the evening of 8/31/2019 through Uber Eats. I received no toppings or dressing on my sandwich--only bread and fish. After contacting the restaurant and speaking to the manager, I didn't receive immediate help or compensation on the botched order. The only assistance I received was "possibly" receiving a discount the next time I order something, however, nothing was guaranteed. I did let the manager know I was unsatisfied with the service and would be writing a review of my poor order.
Best vegan food in Tucson. Very friendly staff and a family oriented atmosphere. My kids and I love eating here.

Y'all, it's taken me a reallllly long time to get on the poke train, but I'm finally here and ho boy is it magical. Most poke offerings always seemed underwhelming to me - crappy quality tuna and tons of sweet or creamy sauces. I wanted something of quality, and I wanted something a little different, ya know?
In walks Poke-Chan.... I LOVE that they offer toppings and sauces you can't get anywhere else locally. They offer scallops and wood ear mushrooms (labeled "fungus") and their tamarind scallion sauce is TO DIE FOR. On top of that, everything is so fresh and flavorful you can't help but love it. Seriously - I've eaten here for twice in the last three days. Try it!!

I was actually kind of excited to try Spaghetti Factory in St. Louis but the experience left much to be desired. It took a good while to have our orders taken and a good while after that to actually receive our food. 

The waiter was quiet and didn't seem like he wanted to help at all, and I get it, it was almost closing time but that's no excuse. 

I ordered the chicken parm, the chicken was ok but the pasta and the sauce was very watery and wasn't seasoned well at all. On the bright side the place is absolutely beautiful and inviting. I love the decor and the style they went with at this one. But the staff needs help and so does the food.

Heard about this place doing a restaurant search of eastern philly area; took me an hour out of my way, but it was worth it; Lunch on a rainy Friday; open at 11, so I got there 10 after and place was on full swing; they change menus every 2 weeks or so; nice train theme, front door even has train signs, and main freight line Philly to Reading, Harrisburg right outside by parking area, maybe 1 or 2 trains an hour pass by, going fast! 
Ok, so all beers on tap on a white board, changed often; I sat at the bar, bartender was very friendly, we exchanged names, he chatted but was efficient.
I had a grilled cheese with brisket & cole slaw on it, excellent; home made chips, a bowl of perfect chili, small order of wings with don't ask sauce for later, and a beer; total was just $33, money well spent; people had ordered take out for their office, was hot & ready; food was fantastic; they really go the extra distance in planning menu, tasty food, and welcoming customer service; there are maybe 5-6 pinball machines to play,  50 cents each. I didn't visit in evening, so can't speak to nightlife scene here, but I would go for sure; another local merchant told me later that, while it is tucked away on a side street, if this was on a main highway this place would be even more thriving. 
The only negative I saw was, a server was there and her boyfriend was sitting at the bar, and she spent more time chatting with him than with her customers; and there seemed to be 4-5 guys sitting around the
Nice place, good atmosphere, but I felt the menu was limited. My food was good and the waitress was exceptional. Can't say I would go here again.

It was a decent place I found it to be a place where regulars came. It wasn't much for new customers not friendly to us not the bartender that evening nor the customers whom I could tell was all very familiar with each other lol which was fine. Now the cook a female was friendly,  kind and extremely helpful and food was AWESOME,  Otherwise the place was for locals who been coming for years and not happy to see newcomers
Just trust me when I say, you must go to Ulele. Food is delicious, so are the cocktails and wine, ambience is great, you won't be disappointed!!

Flautas, Mexican Street corn, duck tacos and hot, fresh churros! Oh, and the house margaritas! What else is there? The atmosphere, funky and fun.  Head over for lunch after you check out the Soudel Market, it's steps away.

My stay at the Nugget wasn't the best experience. I was assigned to the East tower, the freeway could be heard the entire time I was in the room. My key card stopped working twice so I had to go the front desk to get it fixed (really annoying) the rooms were clean but for some reason when I was in it, I just felt gross.. The arcade and the gym was probably the best part of the stay. There were not many tables open for gambling, there was almost a "waiting line" for a blackjack table. I understand that you get what you pay for, but I would much rather go elsewhere.

Went in and the girl working told us they were closing in 7 minutes and they could only make tacos and burritos,  we tried to order shrimp tacos & she said no they couldn't do that or vegetarian tacos because the stuff was already put away.  It would of been more easily accepted if she said any of it with a smile but from the get go she was rude, I think they just didn't want to work.
First time going to Fresco's and the food was delicious, the outside seating was nice, and our waiter was nice.

We've been getting their pulled pork by the pound since the day they opened. It's great for parties and for any kind of family get-together. They pack it and wrap it up very well to keep in all the moisture. It always has a great smoked flavor, and it's even better the next day when reheated. 

I'm also a big fan of their BBQ sauces. The Rump Roaster is a great cayenne pepper based sauce (with a kick). Another favorite is their Tractor Grease sauce which is sweet and tangy. It has become a bit more commercialized now. Once upon a time, they sold their BBQ sauce in mason jars. I kind of liked that because it made it seem very authentic. Nowadays, it's a brand name sauce that is professionally packaged to sell. I think they still use wooden clothes pins to seal up the paper to-go bags, but maybe they have done away with that as well. It's all part of the hillbilly theme.

They have great specials. The people who work there are always friendly. They are always reliable. It's a great place to go for BBQ. Also, if you like Texas toast then you'll definitely like their Bubba bread. The pulled pork goes very well with this bread.

Are you kidding me another jewel on the south side I love wear I live all the best food is around me where to begin. I've drove by this place so many times seen lots of cars in the drive thru  and didn't think too much of it till I went to get my daughter a burger there and tasted hers wow  like I was impressed.  Seriously when I opened the container and unwrapped that cheeseburger it was beautiful the presentation looked like a commercial ad you know almost fake then the taste was phenomenal to me anyways the cheese fries I ate one fry to try yum the cheese was perfectly melted and perfect flavor I got the strawberry shake And the strawberry shortcake oh my goodness the strawberry shortcake looks picture perfect to me like strawberry shake is made from Paris not syrup ma'am I'm telling you what this restaurant is a jewel these people take pride in their food I love that that I love that so much like that makes me wanna go go there again I mean the fact that I love food and you know and they love take pride in their food their presentation in the tases just you got a try it you just have to try it if you've not been there go there they've got a variety of things I got salads I've got hotdogs burgers whatever go check it out and you won't be you won't be disappointed.  It's a bit pricey I just got the number 3 with cheese sauce two small shakes and two shortcakes it was $28 but it was so worth it .

Haven't been to one of these in awhile but it was pretty good today
Had the avacado toast
2 eggs
Orange juice
Eggs Benedict
Home fries were excellent 
I'll go back just for that lol 

I'll return
Tomorrow lol

I love breakfast

I happen to love Greek and Mediterranean food, having spent time in the Med and visiting most countries and enjoying food from all ports of call.

I came here based on my Friends recommendation, of course he was there for dinner with me.  So he wanted my opinion.  

They ordered the flaming cheese (I don't remember the name) and some hummus for appetizer, I ordered Pastitsio for my meal and I make this at home a lot an really enjoy it.  I was concerned about the safety of the waiter the way he was handling the flaming cheese.  Please understand I have seen enough stuff in my life to know when someone needs more training before they turn themselves into a flaming Alpha.  In this case the waiter poured the alcohol over the cheese and it got on his hand and arm then he started to try to light it which I told him he may not want to do this, but he kept going, thankfully his lighter didn't spark as it got wet.  He literally would have been screaming had it lit.

He went back inside and someone else came out with a new flaming cheese and did it correctly.  I still wonder about this option as it can be rather dangerous.  It was tasty though.

My Pastitsio was very good, I like mine with a little kick to it, but theirs was very authentic in taste.  

Why only 4 stars, well even though the food was good it appeared they only had 2 wait staff working or at least staff didn't come by very often to check on us to fill water glasses and such.  I would be happy to come back and give them a
Our dinner was delicious. Started off with Papri chaat appetizer then mutter paner and murg vindaloo entrees. Nice atmosphere and very clean.

I give it three stars only because of the layout , the restaurant inside is pretty nice , the fish tank is a nice touch inside , and the deck is pretty cool with a nice view of the river , to be fair I only had appetizers , but actually a few , it wasn't anything to rave about , the nachos were not very good at all , the white cheese sauce isn't good at all , the beer a bit pricey , I will go again to try the burgers and cheesesteak and at that time I will update my review , if your in the Bensalem area , and want to try or have a drink stop on in and hang at the deck , pretty cool layout , I would skip on the appetizers though
Some of the most bland wings i've had in my life, pizza is decent, not great!  Can't reccomend this place, sorry...

Awesome place for soccer. Many Europeans drink as a community better than we do in the States. A few examples, the Irish and English drink in a communal way we don't in the States. This bar seems to be a good place to encourage such behavior. I came in on a Friday for the US women's World Cup game and this was a great bar for it. The menu was extensive for a modest British pub fare. The draft beer selection here is good enough for an average beer fan. Overall solid place.

I'm bummed.  I was super excited to pick up Nu Yalk pizza and take it home to my fam since I have been craving it for months.  Unfortunately it was so salty none of us could eat it.  I'm not sure what went wrong.  It tasted like someone just dumped a whole container of salt on both pies.  I haven't had Nu Yalk in several years;  maybe they changed recipes.  Maybe it was just a bad day.   I used to love their sauce, but after spending $50 that went in the trash I don't think I'll be back anytime soon.

We went here on a whim while visiting Santa Barbara. It was a very good experience. The menu and pastry choices are easy to understand and we waited a total of less than ten minutes from walking in to first bite.
The Renaud's omelette breakfast with fruit and sourdough toast was delicious, and filling but not too heavy. The mixed berry jam was the star of the meal- applied to toast with butter it is a yummy breakfast dessert.
The cafe au lait I had was pretty good, although I think I would've preferred a lighter roast coffee. I still managed to choke it down though ;)
The service was excellent and efficient. Overall I would absolutely return here and would recommend it to anyone looking for a great breakfast.

We came here Saturday morning for a birthday brunch. Started with the bottomless sangria and the white sangria was amazing. It was crisp and refreshing and we certainly took advantage of the bottomless. I started with the croquettes and they were diving. They melt in your mouth and the fig jam leaves a sweet aftertaste that makes you want to order more! I also had the grilled flatbread. The flavor of the cheese and caramelized onions were amazing. I would have preferred a little more cheese since the crust had a few flavorless bites, but once you kinda smear the egg over the whole thing, it's a very satisfying dish.

We had a large group in our party and our waiter did a wonderful job taking care of us. Our drinks didn't go empty for long, and he was very attentive to make sure we had everything we needed. He had a great personality and made our group feel very comfortable. We would definitely come back here again!
Love the Asian tofu salad (I don't remember it's official name). I appreciate the aesthetic of the place (and the very pretty kombucha bottles) and the water available on the tables.

We ordered three appetizers-ranked in order of best to not so much-Brussel sprouts, meatballs and calamari. The brussels sprouts were awesome and I would order them again. The other two were OK.
I ordered the lamb chops on a bed of sautéed spinach instead of the orzo. They were good but a tad salty.
Finally the best part of my meal was the dessert. The semolina pudding was to die for-not too sweet and just the right texture. Paired with the Greek coffee it was the perfect end to the meal.
Interestingly, we had stopped by Saturday night and the place was packed, one hour wait to get a table. We decided to go on Sunday instead and there was only one other party dining in that day.

Hands down the best fast food choice in west Nashville. The staff is professional and friendly, the food is always great, my order is always correct and they are always fast. Price is great too! Oh, and their shake machine is never "broken"!
it took 1 hour and thirty minutes for 15 fries unbelievable. also someone refilled my sprite like 40 times. also my mac was slimy
Great menu! Big food, for that big appetite! One of my favorite spots for cheat day... Chicken & waffles every time... the best you'll find!
Tried for the first time this past weekend, great ambiance and staff. The lobster queso dip is exceptionally delicious, maybe best dip I've ever had?! Cant wait to try other things from here
Second day in a row I've ordered to go from here. Simple online ordering through the webpage and food was great.
Good service, food n prices.  Huge menu n friendly servers. Huge space good for parties n meetings.

This restaurant just opened up this week! It has been crazy busy! We want on a Wednesday night @ 6 put our name in and was told the wait was 25minutes. We want to the bar for drinks and was served right away! Great drinks and great prices! A manager came over and said are you guys waiting a table we said yes. He sat us right away in a open booth so we only waited like 15minutes! The managers were really active in all interactions. Our server was really quick and friendly! Our food came out really quickly and it was so delicious! All of our steak were cooked to perfection. They even asked when they delivered the steaks to cut into them to see if it's cooked correctly! I would recommend this restaurant if you are looking for a great steak dinner and great drinks!!

I have eaten at the Largo location half a dozen times, and was never disappointed. I believe it's the best fast food chicken around. The grilled tenders are to die for. They have nice healthy sides, and their pies in a jar are delicious.

Baked potatoes soup is my favorite but for lunch their "secret" was out,  My bowl was very hot but the soup was cold and the cheese wasn't even melted so I definitely could tell it was microwaved the soup was still good even cold but nothing should ever be microwaved  I know it's chili's and not some 5 star restaurant but still disappointed.

This is becoming a must-stop any time I have an early morning commute through SB. The service is great. My go-to order is a sesame bagel with cream cheese, onion, and tomato. One of the guys working there recommended some lemon pepper on top, made it even more delicious! Also a fan of the self serve coffee options. Haven't tried the donuts yet, but I assume they are good. This is one of the earliest opening breakfast spots in SB. Treat yourself to a nice to go bagel next time you're in the area and up early!

I have found my Indian food restaurant.  The bread was soft and warm , sag paneer rocked my world, the rice was cooked perfectly and the samosas were crisp on the outside and flavorful on the inside.  The service was exceptional, and I had no complaints.  Definitely worth the lunch special.
The desertes alone are reason enough to go here.

Today my boyfriend and I ordered food from this Chipotle. The lady who made the food only gave each of us half a spoon of protein.. alright ok. Ordered chips and after we got home we found out the cashier forgot our chips... this is the second time this restaurant forgot to give us chips!!! I know it's partly on us not watching her put chips in the bag, but come on. Telling the cashier "I want chips" and having them confirm and reply "Ok" should really be enough. As soon as I opened my salad bowl, a small black bug came out my food... nope! We trashed all of the Chipotle food we ordered today. Chipotle continuously messes up, I feel. We decided to not eat at Chipotle anymore and honestly recommend our friends do the same.
